headlines.description: — Evan Mobley scored 25 points, Donovan Mitchell added 24 and the Cleveland Cavaliers improved to 5-0 with a 134-110 win over the Los Angeles Lakers on Wednesday night in a game that included a special homecoming for LeBron James and his son, Bronny.
headlines.shortLinkText: Cavaliers blow out Lakers 134-110 as Bronny James scores first NBA points as dad watches from bench

events.name: Los Angeles Lakers at Cleveland Cavaliers

headlines.description: — Pascal Siakam scored the last of his 29 points on a 3-pointer with 6.1 seconds left in overtime to give the Indiana Pacers a 135-132 victory over the previously unbeaten Boston Celtics on...
headlines.shortLinkText: Pascal Siakam scores 29 points and makes tiebreaking 3 to send Pacers past Celtics 135-132 in OT

headlines.description: — Tobias Harris had 18 points and 14 rebounds in his Philadelphia return and the Detroit Pistons won for the first time in five games this season, beating the 76ers 105-95 on Wednesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Tobias Harris returns to Philadelphia to help the Pistons win for the first time this season, 105-95

headlines.description: — Bilal Coulibaly scored a career-high 27 points, and the Washington Wizards beat Atlanta 133-120 on Wednesday night for the second win over the Hawks in three days.
headlines.shortLinkText: Coulibaly scores career-high 27, Wizards sweep home-and-home against Atlanta with 133-120 victory

headlines.description: — Karl-Anthony Towns had 44 points and 13 rebounds, Jalen Brunson scored 18 of his 22 points in the second half and the New York Knicks rallied to beat the Miami Heat 116-107 on Wednesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Karl-Anthony Towns scores 44 points, Knicks rally in 2nd half to beat Heat 116-107

events.name: New York Knicks at Miami Heat

headlines.description: — Coby White scored 21 points, Josh Giddey added 20 and the Bulls beat the Magic 102-99 on Wednesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Bulls hold on to beat Magic 102-99 after both teams struggle in 4th quarter

headlines.description: — Dennis Schroder had 33 points and eight assists, Cam Thomas added 19 points and the Brooklyn Nets beat the Memphis Grizzlies 119-106 on Wednesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Dennis Schroder scores 33 points, the Nets beat the turnover-prone Grizzlies 119-106

headlines.description: — Lu Dort scored 20 points, Chet Holmgren added 19 and the Oklahoma City Thunder defeated the San Antonio Spurs 105-93 on Wednesday night to remain the only unbeaten team in the Western Conference.
headlines.shortLinkText: Dort scores 20 points, Holmgren adds 19 as Thunder roll past Spurs 105-93 to remain unbeaten

events.name: San Antonio Spurs at Oklahoma City Thunder

headlines.description: — Buddy Hield scored 21 points, Trayce Jackson-Davis had 15 points and nine rebounds, and the Golden State Warriors beat the New Orleans Pelicans for the second straight night, 104-89 on Wednesday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Trayce Jackson-Davis, Draymond Green lead Warriors to second straight win against Pelicans

events.name: New Orleans Pelicans at Golden State Warriors

headlines.description: — Anfernee Simons scored 25 points, Deandre Ayton had 15 points and 12 rebounds and the Portland Trail Blazers rallied to beat the Los Angeles Clippers 106-105 on Wednesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Anfernee Simons rallies Trail Blazers to 106-105 win over Clippers with 25-point performance

events.name: Portland Trail Blazers at LA Clippers
